LanguageData.RimLocksmith.ApplyDefaultToNewColonyDoor: Use default preset for new colony doors
Newly initialized colony doors receive the current default preset.
LanguageData.RimLocksmith.ManageColonyPawnsDesc: When enabled (default), door configuration shows toggles for colonists, slaves, colony animals and colony mechanoids, allowing you to forbid each group from opening closed colony doors. When disabled, player-faction pawns always follow vanilla rules (vanilla already provides forbidden doors, allowed areas, pens and mechanitor mechanics); these four toggles then have no effect but their configuration is kept.
LanguageData.RimLocksmith.ControlAnomaliesDesc: When off (default), all anomaly entities follow vanilla rules and door configuration does not affect them. When on, hostile anomalies still follow vanilla rules, while non-hostile anomalies (e.g. ghouls, shamblers) are controlled by the "Anomaly entities" toggle in the door configuration.
LanguageData.RimLocksmith.ApplyDefaultToUnconfiguredC: Apply default to unconfigured colony doors
LanguageData.RimLocksmith.ApplyDefaultToAllColonyDoor: Apply default to all colony doors
LanguageData.RimLocksmith.AppliedDefaultCount: Applied RimLocksmith default to {0} colony doors.
LanguageData.RimLocksmith.CurrentConfigMerged: Current configuration (merged view of {0} colony doors, {1} ignored)
LanguageData.RimLocksmith.VanillaNote: Categories not listed here (hostiles, prisoners, wild animals, etc.) always follow vanilla rules and are unaffected by this configuration.
LanguageData.RimLocksmith.AllowOpenTooltip: Controls whether the listed groups may actively open this closed colony door. Already-open doors use vanilla passage behavior. Groups not listed here always follow vanilla rules and are not controlled here.
LanguageData.RimLocksmith.AllowGuests: Guests / visitors (incl. trade caravans and their animals)
